coverage: Root-specified entry receipts and explicitly linked evidence; no full directory sweep or audit acceptance

codec.utf8: Used only if Buffer.from(original.toString("utf8"), "utf8") equals the original bytes
codec.base64: Used for non-UTF8 originals or explicitly indexed byte segments; join segments by offset before verifying the full SHA256
codec.sourcePaths: Provenance only; payload decoding never reads or executes these paths
